app.name: MORPHOS
app.tagline: Digital brains that learn, mutate and evolve.

auth.revisaCorreo: Check your inbox to confirm access
auth.cuentaInactiva: Your account is deactivated. Contact the MORPHOS team to regain access.

empresa.sinEmpresas: You don't belong to any company yet

obra.manoObraDerivada: Labor is derived from check-ins. Hours are never entered by hand.
obra.sinObras: This company has no jobs yet

saldo.explicacion: Your balance belongs to your membership in this company. Switching companies changes it entirely.
saldo.sinRegistros: You have no records in this company yet

bloqueo.descripcion: {empresa}'s membership expired on {fecha}. Your data is intact and everything returns as soon as the payment is recorded.
bloqueo.problema: I have a problem with the payment
bloqueo.problemaEnviado: We opened a high-priority ticket. The MORPHOS team will contact you.
bloqueo.soloSaldo: Your company is blocked. You can view your balance, but not record anything new.

global.sinMora: Prepaid model: there are no overdue memberships.

usuarios.subtitulo: Complete CRUD over every user in the system
usuarios.nuevoAyuda: The account is created already confirmed: they can sign in right away.
usuarios.emailFijo: The email identifies the account and can't be changed here.
usuarios.rolesAyuda: Pick one or more. Each role is held in a different company.
usuarios.coreExcluye: MORPHOS Core is a global role: whoever holds it belongs to no company.
usuarios.unaEmpresaPorRol: Say which company each role applies to. A person can only hold one role per company.
usuarios.sinRolesAun: Pick roles above to assign companies
usuarios.errorSinEmpresa: Some role is missing its company
usuarios.errorEmpresaDuplicada: A person can't hold two roles in the same company
usuarios.raizProtegida: The root account cannot be deleted or demoted.
usuarios.excluyente: morphos_core is exclusive: it cannot belong to any company.
usuarios.activarAyuda: Activate: they will be able to sign in again
usuarios.desactivarAyuda: Deactivate: they will no longer be able to sign in

perfil.avatarAyuda: Link to an image. Leave empty to use your initials.
perfil.emailBloqueado: Your email identifies your account and only the MORPHOS team can change it.
perfil.errorActual: Your current password is not correct
perfil.errorCorta: The password must be at least {min} characters long
perfil.pertenenciasAyuda: Your role, rate and balance belong to each membership, not to you as a person.
perfil.coreSinEmpresas: As MORPHOS Core you belong to no company: your scope is the whole system.

equipo.nuevoAyuda: If they already have a MORPHOS account, they're added to this company without creating another.
equipo.ayuda: Role, rate and balance belong to the membership in this company, not to the person. Changing them here doesn't affect the other companies they work for.
equipo.emailExistente: If they already have an account it's reused and no password is needed.
equipo.datosDeLaPersona: Name and email belong to the person: only they or MORPHOS can change them.
equipo.passwordAyuda: Only for a brand-new account. At least 8 characters.
equipo.tarifaAyuda: Frozen into every block already checked in.
equipo.eliminarConfirmar: {nombre} will no longer belong to {empresa} and will lose access to its data. This can't be undone.
equipo.eliminarNoBorraCuenta: Their MORPHOS account is untouched: if they work for other companies, nothing changes there.
equipo.noBorrarOwner: The owner can't be removed from here
equipo.conHistorial: They have {n} check-ins on record: revoke access with the switch instead of deleting
